continuity: The Murong Family has been annihilated, but Murong Yeonghwi and several dozen survivors escaped; Jeong Hogun is ordered to lead the Embroidered Uniform Guard to Liaoning, and Temur’s tribespeople are ordered to pursue the fugitives.
Jin Wikyung has been forced to rest while recovering from the battle, though he continues to handle documents and direct the response.
Temur remains submitted to Jin Wikyung and is being compelled to help pursue the Murong survivors; exposure of his betrayal would put him at risk from his own tribespeople.
plot: Jin Taekyung reflects on comforting Jin Mukyung after his grief over recent losses, then shares a lighter exchange with Hyuk Mujin. Three days after the victory in Shanxi, Jin Wikyung is made to rest while others handle the aftermath. News arrives that the Murong Family attacked the Hebei Peng Family while pretending to support Shanxi. Peng Cheolyeong and the Bow Saint returned in time to help defeat them, and the Murong Family was annihilated; Murong Yeonghwi and several dozen others escaped. Jin Wikyung orders Temur’s tribespeople to hunt the fugitives, then commands Jeong Hogun to lead the Embroidered Uniform Guard to Liaoning.

Jin Wikyung keeps Temur under control by making clear that his own tribespeople would kill him if they learned the full truth of his betrayal. Jeong Hogun refuses Taekyung’s request as a personal favor but accepts it when Taekyung issues it as an order under his authority as Marquis of Shangshan.
translation_decisions: Render 천호 as “Thousand Captain,” the rank held by Jeong Hogun.
Use “Marquis of Shangshan” for 상산후, the authority Taekyung invokes when commanding Jeong Hogun.
